note:
The subject is #574's second half, and the file it points at moved on 2026-08-28. The resolution itself now lives in tools/runtime-mode.sh, because tools/conformance/functional.sh was found carrying the same silent line one directory over (#504): `RUNTIME="${FEINT_FUNCTIONAL_RUNTIME:-incus-ovn}"`. What varies between the two callers — the subject, the knob, the default, and what `off` would cost — is passed; what does not vary is shared. tools/evidence/mode.sh is now the four facts of the evidence leg and nothing else, which is why the fifth mutation below is on it: change one of those four facts and the leg answers under a runtime nobody chose, which is how a delegation that looks right resolves somebody else's question.

The tests did not move with the code, deliberately: tools/evidence/mode_test.go was written against the behaviour, so it is what proved the extraction changed none of it.
